datasets.title: Nicaragua: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Nicaragua: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nicaragua-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

entity.name: Facebook/Meta AI and Data for Good

lineage.description: Machine learning algorithms identified building footprints from commercial satellite imagery across Nicaragua. Population estimates derived from publicly available census data were spatially distributed using these building locations and demographic modeling in partnership with Columbia University, producing high-resolution gridded population density maps for overall population and seven demographic subgroups.

sources.name: Facebook/Meta AI and Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used to distribute census-based population estimates at high spatial resolution

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population distribution modeling methodology that overlays census data with building footprints to generate high-resolution demographic maps
